fastText lid.176.ftz language-identification model
Copyright Facebook, Inc. Distributed unchanged under Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported; fasttext/LID176-CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt.
Official attribution/model page: https://fasttext.cc/docs/en/language-identification.html
Original model: https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/fasttext/supervised-models/lid.176.ftz
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Trained on Wikipedia, Tatoeba and SETimes data.
References: Armand Joulin, Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Tomas Mikolov,
Bag of Tricks for Efficient Text Classification (2016), https://arxiv.org/abs/1607.01759;
Armand Joulin, Edouard Grave, Piotr Bojanowski, Matthijs Douze, Herve Jegou,
Tomas Mikolov, FastText.zip: Compressing text classification models (2016),
https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.03651.
The model remains a separately licensed, unmodified asset. No endorsement implied.
